    local value = string.sub(str, start_pos, math.min(end_pos, #str))
    return value ~= "" and value or "00"
end

local second = safe_sub(time, 5, 6)
return string.format('%s-%s-%sT%s:%s:%s.00000Z', year, month, day, hour, minute, second)

        return arr
    end
    local is_array = true

        if type(key) ~= "number" or math.floor(key) ~= key then
            is_array = false
            break
        end
    end
    if is_array then
        return _utils.array.markAsArray(value)
    end

end

local iso_time = wf.initVariables.recallTime
if not iso_time or not iso_time:match("^%d%d%d%d%-%d%d%-%d%dT") then
    return nil
end
local year = tonumber(iso_time:sub(1, 4))
local month = tonumber(iso_time:sub(6, 7))
local day = tonumber(iso_time:sub(9, 10))
local hour = tonumber(iso_time:sub(12, 13))
local minute = tonumber(iso_time:sub(15, 16))
local second = tonumber(iso_time:sub(18, 19))
local timestamp = os.time({year = year, month = month, day = day, hour = hour, min = minute, sec = second})
local sign, tz_hour, tz_minute = iso_time:match("([%+%-])(%d%d):(%d%d)$")
if sign and tz_hour and tz_minute then
    local shift = tonumber(tz_hour) * 3600 + tonumber(tz_minute) * 60
    if sign == "+" then
        timestamp = timestamp - shift
    else
        timestamp = timestamp + shift
    end
end
return timestamp
